The search turned up several open Turbopack memory reports on vercel/next.js, mostly for `next dev`, plus a few build-side issues. I did not check current open/closed status on GitHub, so treat "open" as the status shown in the search snippets.

- **Closest match to "leak":** Issue #78534 ("next dev --turbo: memory leak") describes dev-server memory climbing over a few hours on a small app, with restarting as the workaround. It is marked open.
- **Unbounded growth after edits:** A PR on a third-party repo (haileyyycodes/job-search-tracker #61) says Next 16.2.x had a Turbopack dev leak that ended in a heap OOM, and that 16.3 cut dev memory use by up to 90%. That is a secondhand claim, not confirmed by vercel/next.js itself.
- **Root inference causing RAM blowup:** Issue #92978 (open) reports a stray parent lockfile making Turbopack scan a broad directory tree and reach tens of GB of RAM. Issue #94432 (open) covers similar memory pressure from inferred parent roots. Setting `turbopack.root` explicitly is the mitigation people report.
- **Build-side memory:** Issue #97802 (open) reports `next build` saturating a 4 GB container and stalling or OOMing. Issue #99579 (open) reports a persistent cache from a different pipeline raising peak build memory.
- **Other dev reports:** Issue #66326 (open) describes high idle memory and HMR slowdowns. Issue #75142 is an older macOS report that was about high RAM use, not a confirmed leak.
- **Discussions:** Discussion #93451 (May 2026) reports about 7 GB in Turbopack dev versus about 3 GB with Webpack. Discussion #94995 mentions an open report of growth across HMR recompiles, #94696, which was auto-closed by a bot without triage.

Several of these are user reports without maintainer confirmation, and the snippets don't show whether any has been fixed in a specific release.

content.text:
Here are three Turbopack memory issues on vercel/next.js. The search snippets showed them as open, but I couldn't confirm that on GitHub. The GitHub API wasn't available for this repo in this session.

1. **[#78534: next dev --turbo: memory leak](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/78534)**
   This is the closest match to a leak. Dev-server memory keeps climbing over time, and restarting the server is the workaround.

2. **[#92978: Turbopack misdetected workspace root (from stray parent lockfile) causes RAM exhaustion (40+ GB)](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/92978)**
   A stray parent lockfile makes Turbopack pick the wrong root. RAM then balloons and module resolution retries endlessly on the first request.

3. **[#97802: Turbopack build saturates 4 GB and stalls or OOMs](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/97802)**
   This one affects `next build` rather than dev. Memory hits the container limit, and the build stalls or runs out of memory.

Related: [#94432](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/94432) covers memory pressure from inferred parent roots in `next dev`. [#66326](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/66326) covers high memory and HMR freezes.
